verses.text: Ex wetisraelal, ab'ek wal in lolonel yik kusk'olal swalkanel t'a eyib'anh:

Ha ko chonhab' tik, toxo ix lajwiel yuj owal. Lajan icha junok ix kob'es ix, ix lajwi yuj k'e'en espada, ix kan telan t'a sat slu'um, malaj mach skolani yik sk'e wa'an. Ix aktajkan sch'okoj t'a slugar, malaj mach tz'ik'ank'e wa'an.

Ha Jehová Yajal tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Tato a junok he chonhab' tz'ak'anb'at junok mil soldado t'a owal, haxonhej cien ol meltzajok. Tato ay junokxo he chonhab' tz'ak'anb'at cien soldado, haxonhej lajunhwanh ol meltzajok, xchi.
Ha Jehová tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Meltzajanhek t'ayin, yik manh ol ex chamok.

Manh ex b'at t'a chonhab' Betel yet' t'a Gilgal, manh ex b'atpax t'a Beerseba, yujto a heb' aj Gilgal chi', yowalil ol b'atkan heb' preso t'a junok ch'ok nacional, haxo Betel chi', yowalil ol juwokkanb'atok, xchi.
Meltzajanhek t'a Jehová yik manh ol ex chamok. Tato ma'ay, ol yak'kot k'ak' t'a yib'anh he makb'en tik, malaj junok mach t'a Betel ol yal yak'an tupok.
Ha ex wal tze k'ex tojolal t'a chukal, ob'iltak ex, yujto max he b'o yaj heb' anima t'a wach'ilal.

Meltzajanhek t'a Jehová, haton b'oannak k'e'en k'anal skuchan Mootz yet' pax k'e'en k'anal skuchan Oxt'ilanh. Ha pax tz'ak'anoch k'ik' k'inal t'a sakil k'inal, syak'paxoch sakil k'inal chi' t'a k'ik'alk'inalil. Haton pax tz'awtan ha ha' ay t'a ha' mar, sekanem t'a yib'anh lum lum.
Ha tz'ak'an lajwokel heb' soldado tek'an, slajwipaxkanem scuartel heb' yuj, Jehová sb'i.
Ob'iltak ex wal, a ex schichonoch he k'o'ol t'a mach sb'o'an tojolal b'aj tz'och b'eyk'olal, tzeyak'an chukal t'a junok tz'ak'an testigo'al t'a yel.
To tzeyixtej wal heb' meb'a', tzeyik'anek' strigo heb' anima t'a nab'anhej. Manh ol yal-laj eyajek' t'a he pat b'ob'il t'a k'e'en k'e'en, manhxo ol yal pax eyuk'an yal sat te' uwa ix eyawej.

Wojtak jantak juntzanh chukal ix he k'ulej. Manhxalaj slajwub' he mul. Tzeyixtej heb' wach' spensar, tze cha'an k'e'en tumin yik manh wach'ok tzeyutej he b'oan yaj heb' anima. Ha t'a juzgado tzeyak'och t'a yib'anh heb' meb'a' anima wach' spensar.
Yuj chi' a mach ay spensar, tz'em numan, yujto chukxonhej tas tzuji tikne'ik.
Manhxo he k'ulej chukal. Ha wach'il tze k'ulej yik wach' manh ol ex chamok. Tato icha chi', a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, t'a wal yel ol ajnhejek' heyet'ok, icha tz'aj eyalan chi'.

Yajekel chukal. Ha wach'il tze xajanej. Scham heyilani tato wach'xo tz'aj sch'olb'itaj yaj anima t'a juzgado. Tekan icha chi' ol ok' sk'ol Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil t'ayex mach ex yinhtilal ex kan winhaj José.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol och kusk'olal t'a masanil b'ajtak smolb'ej sb'a anima. Ha t'a masanil yoltak calle ol och aw yik yahelal, ol awtaj heb' munlajwum yik tzul ok' heb' yet' heb' yopisio taxon yok'i.
Ayik ol in jawok wak'och yahelal, ol te ok' heb' awum uwa, xchi Jehová.
Ob'iltak wal mach snib'ej sjawi sk'uhal yik yowal sk'ol Jehová. ¿Eyojtak hama tas ol ex aj t'a jun k'uhal chi'? Ha jun k'uhal chi', k'ik' k'inal xonhej ol ajok, manhxa sakil k'inal.

Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', lajan wal ol aj heb' anima icha junok mach tz'el lemnaj t'a junok nok' choj, haxo b'aj ayek' junok nok' oso b'enhej sk'ochi, ma icha yik tz'och junok mach t'a yol spat, tz'och ijan t'a sat k'ilab' yalani, haxo pax junok nok' chan schi'an ta'.
Ha jun k'uhal yik yowal sk'ol Jehová chi', te k'ik' k'inal ol ajok, manhxa jab'ok sakil k'inal ol cheklajok.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Tzin yaja', malaj in gana juntzanh k'inh tzeyak'ochi. Malaj in gana t'a he molanil niwan yelk'och eyalani.

Malaj in gana t'a he silab' tzeyak' t'ayin yuj in eyik'ancha'anh, malaj in gana t'a ixim trigo tzeyak' eyofrenda'ok. Max in chapax nok' wakax b'ak'ech tzeyak' silab'il t'ayin yuj he junk'olal wet'ok eyalani.
Najat tzex el t'a in tz'ey ayik tz'och he jaj he b'itani. Manhxa in gana swab' yoch sjaj eyarpa chi'.
Palta a tas in gana t'ayex to tze b'eyb'alej tojolal icha sb'ey ha ha'. Manh eyaktej he k'ulan wach'il icha junok sjaj ha ha' max tupi.
Ha ex wal tik ex israel, ha t'a 40 ab'il ek'nak heb' he mam eyicham t'a lum tzinan lu'um. ¿Tokwal a t'ayin snhusnak silab' heb' yet' ofrenda ta'?

Ma'ay, palta a heb' chi', skuchnak b'eyek' yenhul yib'anh jun sdiosal heb' skuch Moloc yet' sb'akhnub'al yechel jun Dios Quiún yajb'entak, sb'onak yechel k'e'en k'anal heb' sdiosalok, hanheja' icha chi' tze k'ulej a ex tik.
Yuj chi' ol ex wak'b'at preso t'a yichanhb'at Damasco. Icha chi' tz'aj walan a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, xchi Jehová chi'.
